                    set targetRow to aRow
                    exit repeat
                end if
            end if

        delay 0.5

        delay 0.3

        key code 51 -- backspace/delete key
        delay 0.5

                click deleteBtn
                return "Deleted all WhatsApp items"
            on error e
                return "Dialog not found: " & e
            end try
        end try
    end tell
end tell
